extends SceneTree

## Diagnostic isolation only: one native Terrain3D and one exact baked region.
## No Game singleton, Water scene, grass, vegetation, gameplay or visual proof.
var _terrain: Node3D
var _rig: Node3D
var _failed := false

func _init() -> void:
	_run.call_deferred()

func _mark(phase: String, details: Dictionary = {}) -> void:
	details["phase"] = phase
	details["ticks_usec"] = Time.get_ticks_usec()
	print("TERRAIN DELETE ISOLATION " + JSON.stringify(details))

func _fail(message: String) -> void:
	_failed = true
	_mark("setup_failed", {"message": message})
	push_error(message)
	quit(1)

func _finalize() -> void:
	# MainLoop callback follows root deletion and the second delete-queue flush.
	_mark("root_deleted_and_queue_flushed", {"setup_failed": _failed})

func _run() -> void:
	if DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless":
		_fail("Native isolation requires Forward+ rendering; headless cannot witness GPU cleanup")
		return
	if RenderingServer.get_current_rendering_method() != "forward_plus":
		_fail("Expected Forward+ renderer")
		return
	if not ClassDB.class_exists("Terrain3D"):
		_fail("Pinned Terrain3D extension was not loaded")
		return
	root.tree_exited.connect(_mark.bind("root_tree_exited_before_delete"))
	_rig = Node3D.new()
	_rig.name = "IsolatedTerrainRig"
	root.add_child(_rig)
	var eye := Camera3D.new()
	eye.position = Vector3(256.0, 200.0, 400.0)
	eye.far = 1200.0
	_rig.add_child(eye)
	eye.look_at(Vector3(256.0, 0.0, 256.0))
	eye.make_current()
	_terrain = ClassDB.instantiate("Terrain3D") as Node3D
	_terrain.name = "OneBakedWaterRegion"
	_terrain.set("free_editor_textures", false)
	_terrain.call("set_camera", eye)
	_rig.add_child(_terrain)
	await process_frame
	# Same region size, spacing and FULL_GAME collision mode as water_world.json.
	_terrain.set("region_size", 512)
	_terrain.set("vertex_spacing", 1.0)
	_terrain.set("collision_mode", 3)
	var region: Resource = ResourceLoader.load("res://terrain/terrain3d_00_00.res", "", ResourceLoader.CACHE_MODE_IGNORE)
	if region == null:
		_fail("Pinned baked region could not load")
		return
	var data: Object = _terrain.get("data")
	data.call("add_region", region, true)
	region = null # Native terrain owns its data during deletion, not this local.
	await physics_frame
	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	await process_frame # Free outside the RenderingServer signal callback.
	var collision: Object = _terrain.call("get_collision")
	var body: RID = collision.call("get_rid")
	var regions := int(data.call("get_region_count"))
	var shapes := PhysicsServer3D.body_get_shape_count(body) if body.is_valid() else 0
	var maps_valid := true
	for method: String in ["get_height_maps_rid", "get_control_maps_rid", "get_color_maps_rid"]:
		var map_rid: RID = data.call(method)
		maps_valid = maps_valid and map_rid.is_valid()
	if regions != 1 or shapes <= 0 or not maps_valid or int(_terrain.get("collision_mode")) != 3:
		_fail("Expected one resident region, live FULL_GAME collision and map RIDs")
		return
	_mark("rendered_live_component", {"regions": regions, "collision_shapes": shapes,
		"map_rids_valid": maps_valid, "renderer": RenderingServer.get_current_rendering_method()})
	data = null
	collision = null
	_terrain.call("set_debug_level", ClassDB.class_get_integer_constant("Terrain3D", "INFO"))
	_terrain.tree_exited.connect(_mark.bind("terrain_tree_exited_before_delete"))
	_mark("terrain_free_begin")
	var started := Time.get_ticks_usec()
	_terrain.free() # Normal native notifications/destruction; no destroy bypass.
	_terrain = null
	_mark("terrain_free_returned", {"duration_usec": Time.get_ticks_usec() - started})
	_mark("rig_free_begin")
	started = Time.get_ticks_usec()
	_rig.free()
	_rig = null
	_mark("rig_free_returned", {"duration_usec": Time.get_ticks_usec() - started})
	_mark("quit_requested")
	quit(0)

extends SceneTree

## Diagnostic isolation only: one native Terrain3D and one exact baked region.
## No Game singleton, Water scene, grass, vegetation, gameplay or visual proof.
var _terrain: Node3D
var _rig: Node3D
var _failed := false

func _init() -> void:
	_run.call_deferred()

func _mark(phase: String, details: Dictionary = {}) -> void:
	details["phase"] = phase
	details["ticks_usec"] = Time.get_ticks_usec()
	print("TERRAIN DELETE ISOLATION " + JSON.stringify(details))

func _fail(message: String) -> void:
	_failed = true
	_mark("setup_failed", {"message": message})
	push_error(message)
	quit(1)

func _finalize() -> void:
	# MainLoop callback follows root deletion and the second delete-queue flush.
	_mark("root_deleted_and_queue_flushed", {"setup_failed": _failed})

func _run() -> void:
	if DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless":
		_fail("Native isolation requires Forward+ rendering; headless cannot witness GPU cleanup")
		return
	if RenderingServer.get_current_rendering_method() != "forward_plus":
		_fail("Expected Forward+ renderer")
		return
	if not ClassDB.class_exists("Terrain3D"):
		_fail("Pinned Terrain3D extension was not loaded")
		return
	root.tree_exited.connect(_mark.bind("root_tree_exited_before_delete"))
	_rig = Node3D.new()
	_rig.name = "IsolatedTerrainRig"
	root.add_child(_rig)
	var eye := Camera3D.new()
	eye.position = Vector3(256.0, 200.0, 400.0)
	eye.far = 1200.0
	_rig.add_child(eye)
	eye.look_at(Vector3(256.0, 0.0, 256.0))
	eye.make_current()
	_terrain = ClassDB.instantiate("Terrain3D") as Node3D
	_terrain.name = "OneBakedWaterRegion"
	_terrain.set("free_editor_textures", false)
	_terrain.call("set_camera", eye)
	_rig.add_child(_terrain)
	await process_frame
	# Same region size, spacing and FULL_GAME collision mode as water_world.json.
	_terrain.set("region_size", 512)
	_terrain.set("vertex_spacing", 1.0)
	_terrain.set("collision_mode", 3)
	# Match Terrain3DData::load_region: CACHE_MODE_IGNORE, size check,
	# take_over_path, set_location, set_version, then add_region.
	# Raw ResourceLoader.load alone retains the invalid location sentinel.
	var data: Object = _terrain.get("data")
	data.call("load_region", Vector2i.ZERO, "res://terrain", true)
	await physics_frame
	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	await process_frame # Free outside the RenderingServer signal callback.
	var collision: Object = _terrain.call("get_collision")
	var body: RID = collision.call("get_rid")
	var regions := int(data.call("get_region_count"))
	var shapes := PhysicsServer3D.body_get_shape_count(body) if body.is_valid() else 0
	var maps_valid := true
	for method: String in ["get_height_maps_rid", "get_control_maps_rid", "get_color_maps_rid"]:
		var map_rid: RID = data.call(method)
		maps_valid = maps_valid and map_rid.is_valid()
	if regions != 1 or shapes <= 0 or not maps_valid or int(_terrain.get("collision_mode")) != 3:
		_fail("Expected one resident region, live FULL_GAME collision and map RIDs")
		return
	_mark("rendered_live_component", {"regions": regions, "collision_shapes": shapes,
		"map_rids_valid": maps_valid, "renderer": RenderingServer.get_current_rendering_method()})
	data = null
	collision = null
	_terrain.call("set_debug_level", ClassDB.class_get_integer_constant("Terrain3D", "INFO"))
	_terrain.tree_exited.connect(_mark.bind("terrain_tree_exited_before_delete"))
	_mark("terrain_free_begin")
	var started := Time.get_ticks_usec()
	_terrain.free() # Normal native notifications/destruction; no destroy bypass.
	_terrain = null
	_mark("terrain_free_returned", {"duration_usec": Time.get_ticks_usec() - started})
	_mark("rig_free_begin")
	started = Time.get_ticks_usec()
	_rig.free()
	_rig = null
	_mark("rig_free_returned", {"duration_usec": Time.get_ticks_usec() - started})
	_mark("quit_requested")
	quit(0)
